workflow.title: Safari data on quit: what to check before using Bushfire
workflow.intent: Help a Mac Safari user distinguish browser-session privacy cleanup from a general storage problem, then evaluate compatibility, category controls and sync caveats without promising anonymity.
workflow.description: Bushfire documents Safari cleanup on quit, not general Mac storage diagnosis. Check its version, macOS/Safari compatibility, category choices and iCloud caveats before relying on that workflow.
outline: Conclusion: two different jobs, not interchangeable cleaners
Official panel immediately after lead only once rights and pixel review pass
Choose categories deliberately; distinguish downloads list from files
Resolve release and macOS/Safari compatibility before installation advice
Explain the vendor's iCloud and permissions caveats without changing settings or weakening protections
Use the labeled Breathing Room Space preview for the separate storage-investigation job
Decision checklist and sourced limits; no invented measurements or erasure guarantees
workflow.interactionPass: A non-executing checklist: Safari-session traces or general storage growth? Supported OS/version established? Category loss acceptable? Sync caveat understood? It must not scan, delete, change settings or claim verified compatibility.
workflow.gate: blocked; no article drafted, no route created
